rationale: the query requires exactly one typed selector
two selectors cannot select one object
a stable ID rejects a space
a stable ID rejects lower-case bytes
a logical path rejects an absolute root
a record selector requires a complete digest
a record selector requires an algorithm-qualified digest
a valid selector without a matching object is a not-found input failure
a valid relation selector without a record is a not-found input failure
a valid path without a selected item is a not-found input failure
a valid digest without a stored record is a not-found input failure
